evidence: The paper explicitly states it performs "random forest classification analysis using ranger (v 0.16.0)" to build a predictive model, then uses "a post hoc analysis of our random forest classification model to identify specific bacterial species that are explanatory of our two groups...using FastShap (v 0.1.1)." Figure 3 caption confirms: "SHAP value (SHapley Additive exPlanations) indicates the degree of importance for each variable on the model." SHAP values are model-agnostic explanations based on Shapley values, not impurity-based importance metrics. The paper contains no reference to Gini, MDI, mean decrease in impurity, or ranger's default variable importance output.
